import requests, re, time, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
B62txt="""   A  R  N  D  C  Q  E  G  H  I  L  K  M  F  P  S  T  W  Y  V
A  4 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -1  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  0 -3 -2  0
R -1  5  0 -2 -3  1  0 -2  0 -3 -2  2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
N -2  0  6  1 -3  0  0  0  1 -3 -3  0 -2 -3 -2  1  0 -4 -2 -3
D -2 -2  1  6 -3  0  2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1  0 -1 -4 -3 -3
C  0 -3 -3 -3  9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
Q -1  1  0  0 -3  5  2 -2  0 -3 -2  1  0 -3 -1  0 -1 -2 -1 -2
E -1  0  0  2 -4  2  5 -2  0 -3 -3  1 -2 -3 -1  0 -1 -3 -2 -2
G  0 -2  0 -1 -3 -2 -2  6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2  0 -2 -2 -3 -3
H -2  0  1 -1 -3  0  0 -2  8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2  2 -3
I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3  4  2 -3  1  0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1  3
L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3  2  4 -2  2  0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1  1
K -1  2  0 -1 -3  1  1 -2 -1 -3 -2  5 -1 -3 -1  0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1  0 -2 -3 -2  1  2 -1  5  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1  1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1  0  0 -3  0  6 -4 -2 -2  1  3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4  7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S  1 -1  1  0 -1  0  0  0 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -2 -1  4  1 -3 -2 -2
T  0 -1  0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  5 -2 -2  0
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1  1 -4 -3 -2 11  2 -3
Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3  2 -1 -1 -2 -1  3 -3 -2 -2  2  7 -1
V  0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3  3  1 -2  1 -1 -2 -2  0 -3 -1  4"""
AL=B62txt.split("\n")[0].split(); idx={a:i for i,a in enumerate(AL)}
M20=np.array([[int(x) for x in r.split()[1:]] for r in B62txt.split("\n")[1:]],dtype=np.int32)
def enc(s):
    a=np.array([idx.get(c,-1) for c in s]); return a[a>=0]
def sw(a,b,go=11,ge=1):
    A,B=enc(a),enc(b); n=len(B)
    if n==0 or len(A)==0: return 0,0
    H=np.zeros(n+1,np.int32); E=np.full(n+1,-10**6,np.int32); best=0
    for i in range(len(A)):
        sc=M20[A[i]][B]; Hd=H.copy(); H[0]=0; F=-10**6
        for j in range(1,n+1):
            E[j]=max(E[j]-ge,H[j]-go); F=max(F-ge,H[j-1]-go)
            v=max(0,Hd[j-1]+sc[j-1],E[j],F); H[j]=v
            if v>best: best=v
    return best
E="https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/"
def gp(ids):
    for t in range(4):
        r=requests.get(E+"efetch.fcgi",{"db":"protein","id":",".join(ids),"rettype":"gp","retmode":"text"},timeout=120)
        if "API rate limit" not in r.text[:300]: return r.text
        time.sleep(2)
    return r.text
inter={"D. ananassae":"KPU76596.1","D. yakuba":"KRJ99687.1","D. erecta":"KQS62313.1"}
txt=gp(list(inter.values())); seqs={}
for blk in txt.split("\n//")[:-1]:
    acc=re.search(r"VERSION\s+(\S+)",blk).group(1)
    sq=re.search(r"ORIGIN(.*)",blk,re.S)
    seqs[acc]="".join(re.findall(r"[a-z]+",sq.group(1))).upper()

CG13494="MDDTLSTVEGGMTETSSWSTTIATTTTTEAAKAGSMAVGIIVLIVVMVLLCCLLIICLPLLCLCGCCGLACSACLACDEGCCGEGGGGGCCGDDGGGCCGDGGGCGDCGDGCGDCTLDDD"
CG43405="MAELDATTLSEYDIEYIDFNMTTVAYRTTTGHPDTNLGAWGLLFIFVVIFLIIAACCACMGVLVLFGCMKSFLCFRCRRRGDEFIGREP"
r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",
    params={"query":"gene:CG13488 AND organism_id:7227","format":"fasta","size":3},timeout=60).text
CG13488="".join([b for b in r.split(">") if b.strip()][0].split("\n")[1:])
print("CG13488 (%d aa): %s\n" % (len(CG13488),CG13488))

refs={"CG13494 (120 aa)":CG13494,"CG43405 (89 aa)":CG43405,"CG13488 (%d aa)"%len(CG13488):CG13488}
rows=[]
print("=== Smith-Waterman: the single gene in each outgroup's Fili-to-ppk9 interval vs the three D. melanogaster genes in that interval ===")
for sp,acc in inter.items():
    s=seqs[acc]; d={"species":sp,"accession":acc,"length_aa":len(s)}
    for nm,rf in refs.items(): d[nm]=sw(s,rf)
    rows.append(d)
    print("  %-14s %s (%3d aa): " % (sp,acc,len(s)) + "  ".join("%s SW=%d"%(nm.split()[0],d[nm]) for nm in refs))
tab=pd.DataFrame(rows)
# positive control: the true D. sechellia CG13494 ortholog against the same three references
B4I7W1="MDDTLSTVEGGMAETSSWSTTIATTTTTEAAKAGSMALGIIVLIVVMVLLCCLLIICLPLLCLCGCCVLPCSACLACDEGCCGDDGEGGGGGCCDCGDGCGDCSLDDD"
ctl={nm:sw(B4I7W1,rf) for nm,rf in refs.items()}
print("\n  POSITIVE CONTROL  D. sechellia B4I7W1 (108 aa): " + "  ".join("%s SW=%d"%(nm.split()[0],ctl[nm]) for nm in refs))
print("\nComposition floor established in iteration 2 = SW 121 (best non-self D. melanogaster hit).")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9.5,4.4))
x=np.arange(4); w=0.26
vals={nm:[tab.loc[0,nm],tab.loc[1,nm],tab.loc[2,nm],ctl[nm]] for nm in refs}
cols={"CG13494 (120 aa)":"#c0392b","CG43405 (89 aa)":"#2c7fb8","CG13488 (%d aa)"%len(CG13488):"#7f8c8d"}
for i,(nm,v) in enumerate(vals.items()):
    ax.bar(x+(i-1)*w,v,w,label=nm,color=cols[nm])
ax.axhline(121,color="#e67e22",ls="--",lw=1.4)
ax.text(3.45,126,"composition floor (SW 121)",color="#e67e22",fontsize=8,ha="right")
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(["D. ananassae\nKPU76596","D. yakuba\nKRJ99687","D. erecta\nKQS62313",
                                      "D. sechellia B4I7W1\n(positive control)"],fontsize=8.5)
ax.set_ylabel("Smith-Waterman score"); ax.legend(fontsize=8)
ax.set_title("The one gene occupying the syntenic Fili-to-ppk9 interval in outgroups is the CG43405\northolog. A CG13494 ortholog is present only in the positive control.",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
